title: kcapi hash buffers all input; wolfssl hash streams — inconsistent 1MB cap
description: kcapi_hash.c uses an inbuf accumulator and calls crypto_ahash_digest() in finalize. wolfssl_sha.c calls wc_Sha256Update on every write(). This means: with wolfssl provider, hash of 500MB data works fine (incremental). With kcapi provider, same code hits the 1MB cap silently. Fix kcapi_hash.c to use the incremental ahash API: sess_init allocates ahash_request and calls crypto_ahash_init(); update() calls crypto_ahash_update(); finalize() calls crypto_ahash_final(). Remove inbuf accumulator from kcapi_hash_ctx. This makes kcapi hash behaviour consistent with wolfssl hash.
